`heat-rows.ts`: filas, breadcrumb y opciones de carpeta
summary: New pure module web/src/heat-rows.ts with HEAT_ROW_LIMIT, heatRows, breadcrumb and mainFolderOptions, plus its seven tests, built with the TDD cycle (each test watched failing before the code that passes it). The 0.9 hottest threshold, the 2% bar stub, the eight-row cut, the breadcrumb anchored at the main folder and the option order with dedup are pinned with exact strings. One note for whoever wires the component: the contract's 'then mainFolder if it is not there yet' step in mainFolderOptions is behaviourally unreachable on its own, because breadcrumb always emits the main folder as its first crumb path, so it is kept as written but only the dedup it needs is observable; and mainFolderOptions calls breadcrumb with an empty repo name since only crumb paths are read there, which means a repo name is never needed to build the selector.
